# Paisa Pet – PRD (MVP)

Oct 24, 2026 · @SURAJ DAS

## Purpose of this document

This PRD is the single source of truth for building the Paisa Pet MVP, an offline Android app, by the buildathon deadline of 26 Oct 2026, 11:30 PM IST.

- **Readers:** the builder, any developer, and Claude Code (the coding agent). Every requirement has an ID (US-xx, FR-xx) so work can be split and checked.
- **How to use it with Claude Code:** export this doc as Markdown and save it as docs/prd.md in the project. Save the Stitch screenshots in docs/screens/ with the file names given in "Screens and UI spec". Point Claude Code at one section and one phase at a time (see "Build phases").
- **Precedence:** where a Stitch screen and this PRD disagree, this PRD wins. The differences are listed screen by screen.
- **Source documents:** the earlier "Misc Budget Buddy – MVP Flow & User Stories" doc and the 12 finalised Stitch screens. The product was renamed from Misc Budget Buddy to **Paisa Pet**; the pet itself is called **Buddy**.

## Summary

Paisa Pet keeps a user within the monthly miscellaneous budget they set, with no typing: it reads UPI debit SMS on the phone and asks one question per payment, "Misc or Essential?".

- **Capture:** every UPI debit SMS becomes a transaction automatically, even when the app is closed.
- **Tag:** a notification with two buttons, Misc and Essential, tags it in one tap. Untagged payments count as Misc.
- **See:** Buddy, a pet whose health falls as misc spending rises, shows "₹X left of ₹Y" on the Home screen and a home-screen widget.
- **Trust:** no login, no internet permission, all data stays on the phone.
- **Delivery:** a signed APK shared by link to 4–5 Android testers and the evaluators.

## Problem statement and target user

Young UPI users set a misc budget at the start of the month but only discover at month-end that they overspent, because small payments spread across many apps are never tracked.

- **Who:** a working professional in India, around 22–30, who pays for nearly everything by UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm) at shops, autos, Zomato, Swiggy and quick-commerce apps. Uses an Android phone.
- **Their plan:** after rent, bills, essentials and savings, they set aside a misc amount, for example ₹5,000 a month, for snacks, food orders and small treats.
- **What goes wrong:** ₹30–₹250 payments feel too small to matter, sit in different apps, and are never added up. No single screen shows the misc total, so the overspend is found a month too late.
- **Why existing options fail:** manual trackers need the app opened and the expense typed every time, and people drop them. Bank-linking apps raise privacy worries, cannot tell misc from essential, and only show the total when opened.
- **Evidence:** in a 2024 IIIT Delhi study of 235 UPI users, about 75% said UPI made them spend more. The builder has this problem personally and found the overspend only after the fact.
- **Cost of not solving it:** repeated overspending eats into savings, and the user loses the awareness that paying in cash used to give.

## Objectives and goals

The MVP must prove one thing: if UPI misc spends are captured and tagged with one tap, and the remaining amount is always visible, users stay aware of their misc budget.

**User goals**

1. Know, at any moment, how much misc budget is left this month, without opening a tracker and typing.
2. Tag a payment as Misc or Essential in one tap, within a minute of paying.
3. Feel a nudge before crossing the limit, not after the month ends.

**Project goals (buildathon)**

1. Ship a working, signed APK that installs and runs on real Android phones by 26 Oct 2026.
2. Test it with 4–5 real users for at least 1 full day (Sunday afternoon to Monday) and iterate on their feedback.
3. Capture at least 90% of a tester's UPI debits automatically, measured against their UPI app history.

## Success metrics

The primary metric is categorised coverage: the share of a tester's UPI debits that end up captured and tagged within 24 hours, target 80% or more.

| Type                | Metric               | Definition                                                                                    | Target (test period)            | How measured                                      |
| ------------------- | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| Primary             | Categorised coverage | UPI debits captured and tagged Misc or Essential within 24 h ÷ all UPI debits the tester made | ≥ 80% (stretch 90%)             | Tester's CSV export vs their GPay/PhonePe history |
| Secondary           | Capture rate         | UPI debits auto-captured from SMS ÷ all UPI debits made                                       | ≥ 90%                           | CSV export vs UPI app history                     |
| Secondary           | One-tap tag rate     | Transactions tagged from the notification ÷ transactions captured                             | ≥ 70%                           | CSV export (tag source column)                    |
| Secondary           | Time to tag          | Median minutes from SMS to tag                                                                | ≤ 2 min                         | CSV export (captured and tagged timestamps)       |
| Secondary           | Widget adoption      | Testers who add the widget to their home screen                                               | ≥ 50%                           | Screenshot or follow-up call                      |
| Secondary           | Day-3 retention      | Testers still tagging on day 3                                                                | ≥ 60%                           | CSV export                                        |
| Secondary           | Budget awareness     | "I knew how much misc budget I had left", 1–5                                                 | Average ≥ 4                     | Exit survey                                       |
| Lagging (after MVP) | Months within budget | Months that end with misc spend ≤ budget                                                      | Up vs the user's previous month | In-app history                                    |
| Guardrail           | Wrong captures       | Non-UPI, credit, OTP or failed messages saved as transactions ÷ all captured                  | ≤ 2%                            | CSV review with tester                            |
| Guardrail           | Duplicates           | One payment saved twice                                                                       | 0                               | CSV review                                        |
| Guardrail           | Parse errors         | Wrong amount or blank payee on a captured transaction                                         | ≤ 5%                            | CSV review                                        |
| Guardrail           | Notification fatigue | Testers who turn off Paisa Pet notifications                                                  | ≤ 1 of 5                        | Follow-up call                                    |
| Guardrail           | Stability            | Crashes reported during the test                                                              | 0 blocking crashes              | Tester reports, Logcat                            |
| Guardrail           | Privacy              | Network calls made by the app                                                                 | 0 (no INTERNET permission)      | Manifest check                                    |

The app is offline and has no analytics, so every metric is measured from the CSV export, the tester's UPI app history, a short exit survey and a follow-up call.

## Scope and non-goals

The MVP covers one user, one budget (misc), two categories (Misc and Essential) and UPI debits only.

**In scope (MVP)**

- Onboarding: welcome, set monthly misc budget, permissions (SMS and notifications) with a denied state.
- Automatic capture of UPI debit SMS, with filtering and de-duplication.
- One-tap Misc/Essential notification; untagged payments count as Misc.
- Home (Buddy, ₹ left, % used, recent payments), Transactions list, Edit and Add sheets, Settings with CSV export.
- Buddy's five health states, 75% and 100% alerts, monthly reset.
- Home-screen widgets (small 2x2 and wide 4x2).
- A debug-only "Simulate SMS" tool for testing without real payments.

**Non-goals (not in this version)**

| Out of scope                                                                       | Why                                                |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| Login (Gmail or any), cloud backup, sync across phones                             | No user value without a server; adds days of setup |
| Card, ATM, NEFT/IMPS and NACH/ECS auto-debit transactions (UPI AutoPay mandate payments are in scope) | Decided: UPI debits only, to keep parsing reliable |
| Reading GPay/PhonePe app notifications                                             | Second capture path; v2 if SMS gaps prove large    |
| More categories, sub-categories ("Chai & Snacks"), quick tags, splitting a payment | Two buckets answer the core question               |
| Remembering payees to auto-tag, AI payee detection ("Detected as Tea Stall")       | Needs data first; v2                               |
| Insights and coaching ("Buddy says…", week-over-week comparisons)                  | Not needed to prove awareness                      |
| Floating on-screen character, screenshot capture, "Tap Buddy to cheer", "Revive"   | Extra permissions and polish; v2                   |
| In-app notification centre (bell icon), profile/avatar                             | No login, nothing to show                          |
| iPhone, Play Store release                                                         | iOS cannot read SMS; Play Store restricts SMS apps |

Setup happens once; after that, every UPI debit SMS leads to one tap, and only Misc (or no answer) lowers Buddy's health.

## Screens and UI spec

The app has 9 in-app screens or sheets, plus notifications and two widgets; the Stitch screenshots are the visual reference and the changes below override them.

**Global design rules**

- Material 3 with Jetpack Compose, light theme first (dark theme follows system colours, P1). Portrait only.
- Cards: white on a light grey background, rounded corners (about 16–24 dp), generous spacing. Primary action colour: the royal blue in the screenshots.
- Buddy's state colours drive the progress bar, state chip and widget: Thriving green, Fine lime, Worried amber, Sick orange, Fainted red. Match the hues in 12-buddy-states.png.
- Money in Indian format: ₹5,000, ₹1,00,000. Debits shown as "–₹240". No paise on screen unless non-zero.
- App name everywhere is **Paisa Pet** (screens say "Budget Buddy" or "Misc Budget Buddy": rename). The pet is "Buddy".
- Navigation: bottom bar with **Home** and **Transactions**. "+ Add expense" button on both. Settings via the gear on Home. No bell icon, no profile avatar anywhere.
- Save the screenshots in docs/screens/ with the file names below.
- Dynamic colour is off; the app uses the light colour scheme only and the system font (Roboto). MainActivity is locked to portrait (Android 16 and later ignore the lock on tablets and foldables).

## Functional requirements

Each requirement lists testable acceptance criteria; all are P0 except FR-17, FR-21 and FR-22, which are P1.

**Onboarding and setup**

- **FR-01 Onboarding (P0).** First launch shows S1 → S2 → S3 → Home. After "Go to Home", an onboardingComplete flag is saved and later launches open Home directly. Killing the app mid-onboarding resumes at S1 with any saved budget kept.
- **FR-02 Budget (P0).** Budget accepts whole rupees ₹100–₹10,00,000; anything else disables Continue with an inline message. Saved as the budget for the current month and as the default for future months. Editing in Settings changes the current month only from that moment; totals and Buddy update at once. Editing the budget later (Settings) reuses the same save and keeps that month's alert flags.
- **FR-03 Permissions (P0).** Each Allow button requests one runtime permission (RECEIVE_SMS; POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android 13+). Given SMS is denied, the denied card shows and manual add still works. Given permission is later revoked, Home shows a banner "Auto-tracking is off" with Open Settings. On Android 12 and below POST_NOTIFICATIONS does not exist: the Notifications card shows 'Not needed'.

**Capture and tagging**

- **FR-04 Detect UPI debits (P0).** Given a UPI debit SMS arrives, when the app is closed or the phone locked, then a transaction is saved within 5 seconds. Non-UPI, credit, OTP, failed and promotional messages create nothing. AutoPay payments that report money sent are captured. Rules in "SMS capture and parsing rules".
- **FR-05 Extract fields (P0).** Each saved transaction has amount (exact to the paisa), payee (name or UPI ID, or "UPI payment" if none), UPI reference if present, bank sender ID and the transaction date (from the message, falling back to SMS time).
- **FR-06 No duplicates (P0).** The same payment arriving twice is saved once: the same message (same sender and body), or the same UPI reference. If both have a reference and the references differ, they are different payments, even with the same amount, payee and time. Only when a reference is missing: same amount and same payee within 2 minutes.
- **FR-07 Tag prompt (P0).** Each new SMS transaction posts a notification with the title "₹240 paid to Swiggy" and the text "Misc or Essential spend? Tap to tag." with buttons **Misc** and **Essential**. Tapping a button saves the category without opening the app and updates Home and widgets. Tapping the body opens S7 for that transaction. Swiping it away leaves it Not tagged.
- **FR-08 Untagged counts as Misc (P0).** Not tagged transactions are included in misc spent and shown with a Not tagged chip until the user picks a category.

**Budget, Buddy and screens**

- **FR-09 Budget maths (P0).** Misc spent, ₹ left, % used and pace follow "Budget logic" exactly. Amounts recalculate on every insert, edit, delete or budget change.
- **FR-10 Buddy states (P0).** Buddy's face, colour and label match the five states in "Budget logic", everywhere Buddy appears.
- **FR-11 Home (P0).** Matches S4 when the month is empty and S5 otherwise; the untagged card shows only when untagged > 0; Recent shows the 5 newest; data refreshes live (Flow from Room).
- **FR-12 Transactions (P0).** Lists the current month newest first, grouped by day with day totals; filter chips show counts and filter instantly; header totals match Home.
- **FR-13 Edit and delete (P0).** Category change saves on "Save changes". Delete asks to confirm, then removes the transaction and recalculates. SMS transactions keep amount and payee read-only; manual ones are fully editable.
- **FR-14 Manual add (P0).** Amount > 0 required; Paid to optional; category defaults to Misc; date within the current month, not in the future. Saved with source = Manual and no notification.
- **FR-15 Widgets (P0).** Small and wide widgets show Buddy's state and ₹ left (wide: also budget, % used, last payment, + Add). Tapping opens Home; + Add opens S8. Widgets refresh within 5 seconds of any change and shortly after midnight (not built in v0.1: the widgets pick up a new month the first time any refresh trigger fires). **Built in v0.1.**
- **FR-16 Month reset (P0).** On the 1st, the new month starts at 0 spent with the default budget; Home, widgets and alerts use the new month. Past transactions are kept. Widget part partly deferred: without the midnight job, a placed widget switches month at the next refresh trigger.
- **FR-18 CSV export (P0).** Exports all transactions with the columns in "Data model" through the Android share sheet. File name paisa-pet-YYYY-MM-DD.csv. Works offline. Export uses the Android share sheet and a FileProvider (cache/exports, old files deleted before each export). The file is UTF-8 with a BOM, CRLF line ends, rows oldest first. Values: Misc / Essential / Not tagged, SMS / Manual, Notification / App / empty. A text cell starting with =, +, -, @ or a tab gets a leading apostrophe so spreadsheets do not run it as a formula.
- **FR-19 Simulate SMS (P0, debug only).** Settings › Simulate SMS lets the builder paste a message body and sender ID and run it through the full pipeline (parse → save → notify). Absent in release builds.
- **FR-20 Privacy (P0).** No INTERNET permission in the manifest. Raw SMS text is never stored; only parsed fields and a hash for de-duplication. Cloud backup is switched off (allowBackup=false), so payment data never leaves the phone. No INTERNET permission. Libraries add WAKE_LOCK, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and FOREGROUND_SERVICE (WorkManager for the widgets); none of them can send data.
- **FR-23 Past months (P0).** The month dropdown on Home and Transactions lists months with data; past months are read-only views with that month's budget.

**Alerts and P1 extras**

- **FR-17 Limit alerts (P1).** When % used first reaches 75% in a month, post 'Buddy is getting sick' / '₹X misc left this month.' When it first goes over 100%, post 'Buddy fainted' / 'You've crossed your ₹Y misc budget. You are ₹Z over budget.' Each fires once per month; it re-arms if a budget increase or edit drops % below that level. Deferred to v0.2; not in v0.1. The channel budget_alerts exists and nothing posts to it. When built: hold back the payment whose prompt was just shown until it is tagged (so an untagged rent payment does not trigger 'Buddy fainted'); a late SMS from a past month never alerts.
- **FR-21 Undo (P1).** After a tag from the notification, the notification changes to "Added to Misc · ₹1,560 left" with **Undo** for 10 seconds; Undo sets it back to Not tagged.
- **FR-22 Quick add (P1).** Home shows chips +₹20 Chai, +₹50 Auto, +₹100 Quick; a tap opens S8 pre-filled (amount, Paid to, Misc).
## SMS capture and parsing rules

An SMS becomes a transaction only if it is a UPI payment AND a debit AND not on the exclusion list; parsing runs on the phone with plain pattern rules, never an online service.

**Pipeline (in order)**

1. SMS_RECEIVED broadcast arrives (manifest-registered receiver, works with the app closed). Join multi-part messages from the same sender into one body.
2. Quick reject: sender is a phone number (10+ digits, personal SMS) → drop. Bank senders are alphanumeric IDs such as VM-HDFCBK or AX-SBIUPI.
3. Classify with the rules below. Not a UPI debit → drop silently (the debug Simulate SMS screen shows the reason; nothing is ever logged).
4. Extract fields. No amount found → drop.
5. De-duplicate. Duplicate → drop.
6. Save as Not tagged with source = SMS, then post the tag prompt (FR-07) and refresh widgets.

Work after step 1 runs off the main thread (goAsync() plus a coroutine, or an expedited WorkManager job).

How it is built: the parser uses one template per bank wording. HDFC has three: the regular 'Sent Rs.X From HDFC Bank A/C *1234 To <payee> On <date> Ref <12 digits>' (UPI ID or merchant), the AutoPay variant, and the payment to a bank account 'HDFC Bank:Rs. X debited from a/c *1234 on <date> to a/c **5678 (UPI Ref No. <12 digits>)'. SBI and ICICI have one each. If no template matches, a guarded generic fallback captures the message only when ALL hold: the sender looks like a bank header; the word UPI and exactly one 12-digit reference are present; an explicit debit phrase (debited from/by/for/with, Sent Rs) is present; a readable amount is present; and none of credited, received, refund, reversed, card, ATM, NEFT, IMPS, RTGS, OTP, failed, declined, pending appear. A fallback capture uses the payee 'UPI payment'. Anything else is ignored: a miss is always preferred to a wrong capture. The table below says what must hold; where it differs from the fixtures in docs/sample-sms.txt, the fixtures win. To support a new bank wording, first add real redacted samples to docs/sample-sms.txt, then a template.

**Classification rules** (case-insensitive)

| Check              | Counts as a match when the body…                                                                                               | If it fails                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| Is UPI             | contains "UPI", or a UPI ID pattern \[\\w.\\-\]+@\[a-zA-Z\]{2,}, or "UPI Ref" / "RRN"                                          | Drop (card, ATM, NEFT, IMPS, NACH) |
| Is debit           | contains debited, debit, sent, paid, spent, or "Dr" next to the amount                                                         | Drop                               |
| Not credit         | The account is on the paying side: the message says debited / debited by / debited for / Sent ... from. Words like credited, received, refund, reversed or cashback mean money came in, EXCEPT an ICICI-style debit that names the payee before 'credited' (e.g. '...debited for Rs 620.00 on 27-Jun-26; BIRRA BEVERAGES credited. UPI:...'), which is still a debit | Drop                               |
| Not failed         | does not contain failed, declined, unsuccessful, not processed                                                                 | Drop                               |
| Not OTP or request | does not contain OTP, one time password, "will be debited", "requested money", "collect request", mandate created / registered | Drop                               |

Decide direction per bank template (HDFC 'Sent ... from ... To', SBI 'debited by ... trf to', ICICI 'debited for ...; payee credited'), not by single words. docs/sample-sms.txt is the reference.

UPI AutoPay (mandate) payments: a message that reports money actually sent (for example 'UPI Mandate: Sent Rs.304.00 from ... To ...') is a UPI debit and is captured like any other. Mandate set-up, approval and 'will be debited' notice messages move no money and are dropped, so a payment is never counted twice. Never drop a message just because it contains the word 'mandate'.

**Field extraction**

- **Amount:** first match of (?:Rs\\.?|INR|₹)\\s?(\[\\d,\]+(?:\\.\\d{1,2})?) that is NOT preceded within 12 characters by "Bal", "balance", "Avl" or "Available". Store in paise as a whole number. SBI messages print the amount with no Rs or INR (for example 'debited by 49.00'), so also accept the number right after 'debited by'.
- **Payee:** text after "to", "paid to", "trf to" or "VPA" up to the next keyword (on, Ref, UPI, date) or full stop; else the first UPI ID in the body; else "UPI payment". Trim and cap at 40 characters. ICICI: the text between ';' and ' credited'. HDFC: the text after 'To' up to the line break or date. HDFC: an optional word 'On' before the date is not part of the payee. An HDFC payment to a bank account prints the account (for example a/c **0875) as the payee.
- **UPI reference:** 12-digit number after Ref, Ref No, Refno, RRN, UPI Ref or UPI:, if present.
- **Transaction date (occurredAt):** the date printed in the message, read day-first as the bank writes it (03/10/26, 28Sep26, 28-Jun-26, 21-10-26). Time of day comes from the SMS received time. If no date can be read, use the SMS received time. A transaction belongs to the month of this date in the phone's local time zone.
- **Bank:** the sender ID with its 2-3 letter prefix and one-letter suffix removed (AD-HDFCBK-S becomes HDFCBK).

**De-duplication key**

- Same message: smsHash = SHA-256 of sender + a newline character + body. The same hash already saved → duplicate, so the same SMS re-delivered is ignored. The hash input never changes once testers install the app.
- Both have a UPI reference: duplicate only if the references are equal. Different references are different payments, even with the same amount, payee and time.
- A reference is missing on either side: same amount and same payee (ignoring case and spaces at the ends) within 2 minutes → duplicate.

**Fixtures (required before coding Phase 1)**

Bank formats differ and change, so the parser is built and unit-tested against real messages, not guesses. Collect 15–20 real UPI debit SMS from at least 4 banks (HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis or Kotak), plus 5–10 messages that must be rejected (credit, OTP, card spend, failed, collect request). Mask account numbers and save them in docs/sample-sms.txt with an expected result for each line. Status after Phase 3: 36 fixture blocks: 15 debits (HDFC in three wordings, SBI, ICICI and made-up edge cases), 20 ignore cases and 1 duplicate. Axis, Kotak and other banks need real samples from testers.

## Budget logic, Buddy states and alerts

Only Misc and Not tagged payments in the current calendar month count against the budget; Essential never does.

**Formulas** (month = calendar month in the phone's time zone, 1st 00:00 to last day 23:59)

- miscSpent = sum of amounts where category is MISC or UNTAGGED and occurredAt (the transaction date) is in the month.
- left = budget − miscSpent (can be negative; show "₹Z over budget" when below 0).
- pctUsed = miscSpent ÷ budget × 100, rounded down to a whole number for display; use the exact value for state and alerts.
- daysLeft = days from today to month-end, counting today. pace = max(left, 0) ÷ daysLeft, shown as "₹P/day for D days left".
- essentialSpent and total debits are shown on Transactions only.

**Buddy states**

| % used (exact) | State    | Buddy                  | Colour | Home label                 |
| -------------- | -------- | ---------------------- | ------ | -------------------------- |
| 0 to under 25  | Thriving | Big smile, full health | Green  | "Buddy is thriving"        |
| 25 to under 50 | Fine     | Content                | Lime   | "Pacing smoothly"          |
| 50 to under 75 | Worried  | Anxious, sweat drop    | Amber  | "Buddy is getting nervous" |
| 75 to 100      | Sick     | Thermometer, unwell    | Orange | "Buddy is getting sick"    |
| over 100       | Fainted  | Knocked out, X eyes    | Red    | "Buddy fainted"            |

Buddy art: one vector drawable per state (exported from the Stitch screens or redrawn as simple Compose shapes). The same five assets serve Home, widgets and notification icons. v0.1 uses five placeholder vector drawables (res/drawable/buddy_*.xml, mapped only in ui/buddy/BuddyArt.kt); real art replaces those five files.

**Alerts (FR-17)**

- Store alerted75 and alerted100 per month. When pctUsed reaches 75 (or goes over 100) and the flag is false, post the alert and set the flag.
- If an edit, delete or budget increase takes pctUsed back below that level, clear the flag so it can fire again.
- A single payment that jumps past both levels posts only the 100% alert.

**Month rollover**

- No data is deleted. The current month is computed from the clock, so screens switch automatically.
- A month with no budget row uses the default budget, so month reset needs no database work. The daily WorkManager job just after midnight only refreshes the widgets.

## Notifications and widget spec

Two notification channels and two Glance widgets; every tag, edit or budget change must reach both within 5 seconds.

**Notification channels**

| Channel                         | Importance      | Used for                                          |
| ------------------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| tag_prompts — "Payment tagging" | High (heads-up) | Misc or Essential prompts, confirmation with Undo |
| budget_alerts — "Budget alerts" | Default         | 75% and over-100% alerts                          |

**Tag prompt** (10-notifications.png, top card)

- Title "₹240 paid to Swiggy"; text "Misc or Essential spend? Tap to tag."; small icon = Paisa Pet; large icon = Buddy's current state.
- Actions **Misc** and **Essential**: PendingIntent (immutable) to a TagActionReceiver carrying the transaction ID. The receiver updates Room, refreshes widgets, then cancels or updates the notification.
- Notification ID = transaction ID, so several prompts can coexist and each acts on its own payment.
- Body tap opens S7 for that transaction. Swipe away = stays Not tagged. Prompts are not repeated.
- If notifications are off, the transaction still saves and appears as Not tagged.
- On the lock screen the notification shows 'New UPI payment · Unlock to tag' (private visibility); the amount, payee and buttons show after unlock.
- When the payee is 'UPI payment', the title is '₹240 UPI payment'.
- The body tap opens the Edit screen (S7) for that payment; until S7 exists it just opens the app.
- The tag prompt's large icon (Buddy's state) is not built in v0.1.

**Confirmation with Undo (P1, FR-21)**

- After a tap, update the same notification to "Added to Misc · ₹1,560 left" with an **Undo** action, auto-dismissed after 10 seconds (setTimeoutAfter).

**Alerts (P1, FR-17)** — with live numbers: 'Buddy is getting sick' / '₹X misc left this month.' and 'Buddy fainted' / 'You've crossed your ₹Y misc budget. You are ₹Z over budget.' (title / text). Tap opens Home. Deferred to v0.2; not in v0.1. The channel budget_alerts exists and nothing posts to it. When built: hold back the payment whose prompt was just shown until it is tagged (so an untagged rent payment does not trigger 'Buddy fainted'); a late SMS from a past month never alerts.

**Widgets** (11-widgets.png), built with Jetpack Glance

| Widget | Size | Shows                                                                                                                                   | Tap                        |
| ------ | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Small  | 2x2  | "Paisa Pet", Buddy, "₹X left of ₹Y", progress bar in state colour                                                                       | Opens Home                 |
| Wide   | 4x2  | Buddy, "₹X left", "Budget ₹Y for &lt;Month&gt;", "NN% used" chip, progress bar, last payment line ("–₹240 · Swiggy · Misc"), **\+ Add** | Opens Home; + Add opens S8 |

- Refresh: call updateAll() after every insert, tag, edit, delete or budget change, plus a daily job shortly after midnight (not built in v0.1: the widgets pick up a new month the first time any refresh trigger above fires).
- Before onboarding is complete, widgets show "Set up Paisa Pet" and open S1.
- Changes vs screenshot: remove the "Glance" badge, the search bar and the "Material You widgets" labels (they are mock-up chrome).
- Both widgets refresh after every payment, tag, edit, delete, add, budget change and onboarding change, whenever the app comes to the foreground, and when the time or time zone changes; with no widget placed nothing runs. The month label is the short month ('Budget ₹5,000 for Oct'). Over budget the amount is shown in red as 'over budget of ₹X'. '+ Add' opens the Add expense sheet on Home for the current month; tapping elsewhere opens Home. The widgets always show the current month. A wide-widget tap during onboarding just opens the app.

## Data model

Two Room tables and a few DataStore preferences hold everything; money is stored as whole paise (Long) to avoid rounding errors.

**Table transactions**

| Column               | Type                             | Notes                                                                |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id                   | Long, PK, auto                   | Also the notification ID                                             |
| amountPaise          | Long                             | \> 0                                                                 |
| payee                | String                           | Name, UPI ID, or "UPI payment"; manual entries may be "Manual entry" |
| upiRef               | String?                          | 12-digit reference when present; checked for duplicates              |
| bank                 | String?                          | Sender ID without prefix, e.g. HDFCBK                                |
| occurredAt           | Long (epoch ms)                  | Date printed in the SMS (time of day from SMS received time; falls back to received time), or the date/time picked for manual entries |
| monthKey             | String YYYY-MM                   | Indexed; derived from occurredAt in local time                       |
| category             | Enum MISC / ESSENTIAL / UNTAGGED | SMS entries start UNTAGGED; manual default MISC                      |
| source               | Enum SMS / MANUAL                |                                                                      |
| tagSource            | Enum NOTIFICATION / APP / null   | Where the category was last set; for metrics                         |
| taggedAt             | Long?                            | When the category was last set                                       |
| smsHash              | String?, unique                  | SHA-256 of sender + a newline character + body; raw body is never stored; this input never changes once testers install |
| createdAt, updatedAt | Long                             | createdAt = capture time                                             |

**Table month_budgets**

| Column                | Type       | Notes                 |
| --------------------- | ---------- | --------------------- |
| monthKey              | String, PK | YYYY-MM               |
| budgetPaise           | Long       | Budget for that month |
| alerted75, alerted100 | Boolean    | Alert flags (FR-17)   |

**DataStore preferences:** onboardingComplete (Boolean), defaultBudgetPaise (Long, used to create each new month's row).

**CSV export columns (FR-18):** date, time, amount_inr, payee, category, source, tag_source, upi_ref, bank, captured_at, tagged_at. Amounts in rupees with 2 decimals; times in local yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

## Edge cases

The riskiest edge cases are missing SMS for small payments and phones that block background work; both have a defined fallback.

| Area    | Case                                                                                                   | Expected behaviour                                                                                                  |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Capture | Bank sends no SMS for small UPI payments (e.g. some banks skip debits under ₹100) or UPI Lite payments | Not captured; user adds them manually (FR-14). Mentioned in S8 helper text and tester guide                         |
| Capture | SMS arrives while the phone is off or in airplane mode                                                 | Captured when it arrives; the transaction date comes from the message, time of day from the SMS timestamp           |
| Capture | Brand phones (Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Realme) block background apps                                        | Tester guide asks to allow Autostart and set battery to "No restrictions". Permissions screen links to app settings |
| Capture | Multi-part (long) SMS                                                                                  | Parts joined before parsing                                                                                         |
| Capture | Dual SIM or several banks                                                                              | All handled; bank stored per transaction                                                                            |
| Capture | Same payment notified twice (SMS re-delivery, two senders)                                             | Saved once (FR-06)                                                                                                  |
| Capture | Message mentions both the amount and the account balance                                               | Balance amount ignored (parsing rules)                                                                              |
| Capture | Failed payment followed by a reversal SMS                                                              | Failed message dropped; reversal is a credit, dropped                                                               |
| Capture | Refund of an earlier payment                                                                           | Not captured as income in MVP; user edits or deletes the original if needed                                         |
| Capture | Personal SMS that looks like a payment                                                                 | Dropped: sender is a phone number                                                                                   |
| Capture | Payment made before install or before SMS permission                                                   | Not captured (no back-fill in MVP); add manually                                                                    |
| Capture | Mandate pre-debit notice, then the actual debit                                                        | Only the 'Sent' debit message is captured; the notice is dropped.                                                   |
| Capture | A payment is added by hand and then its SMS arrives                                                    | Both are saved, because manual entries are not part of the duplicate check; the user deletes one                    |
| Capture | The app was force-stopped, or freshly installed and never opened                                       | Android delivers no SMS to the app until it is opened once. Swiping it away from Recents is fine. The tester guide says so. |
| Capture | Android blocks the SMS permission for an APK installed from a browser or file manager (Restricted setting) | Tester guide: App info, the three-dot menu, Allow restricted settings, then allow SMS.                           |
| Capture | A bank wording the parser does not know                                                                | Not captured, or captured by the guarded fallback with the payee "UPI payment". Testers add missed payments with + Add expense and send the masked SMS so a template can be added. |
| Capture | A payment to the user's own account (self-transfer)                                                    | Captured like any other; the user tags it Essential or deletes it. |
| Capture | A late SMS for a payment made last month                                                               | Filed under the month of the date in the message; the notification's Misc and Essential buttons still work; in the app that month is view-only. |
| Tagging | User never taps the notification                                                                       | Stays Not tagged, counts as Misc, shown on Home card                                                                |
| Tagging | Several prompts pending                                                                                | Each acts on its own transaction ID                                                                                 |
| Tagging | Notification permission off                                                                            | Transactions still saved; Home shows untagged card                                                                  |
| Tagging | Tapping a button for a transaction since deleted                                                       | No-op; notification dismissed                                                                                       |
| Budget  | Budget changed mid-month                                                                               | Applies to the current month at once; alerts re-evaluated                                                           |
| Budget  | Spend exactly equal to budget                                                                          | 100% used, state Sick, ₹0 left; the over-budget alert has not fired yet                                             |
| Budget  | Way over budget (e.g. 300%)                                                                            | Progress bar full red, "₹Z over budget", Fainted                                                                    |
| Month   | Payment at 23:59 on the last day, tagged after midnight                                                | Counts in the month of occurredAt, not the tag time                                                                 |
| Month   | Phone time zone or date changed                                                                        | Months follow the phone's local date                                                                                |
| Month   | SMS for a payment made last month arrives after month-end                                              | Filed under the month of the date in the message. If that month has no budget row, create one from the default budget. |
| Month   | The phone's time zone changes while the app is open | The app follows the system time zone at the moment of use; each payment keeps the month it was saved under. |
| Manual  | Amount 0, negative or non-numeric                                                                      | Add disabled with inline error                                                                                      |
| Manual  | Date in the future or outside the current month                                                        | Not allowed in date picker                                                                                          |
| Data    | App uninstalled                                                                                        | All data lost; Settings warns to export first                                                                       |
| Data    | Very large amount (e.g. ₹50,000 rent paid by UPI)                                                      | Captured; user tags Essential                                                                                       |
| Data    | A payment is deleted and the bank re-sends the identical SMS | It is captured again. |

## Tech stack, dependencies and infrastructure

A single native Android app in Kotlin with no backend; the only infrastructure is the build machine, a GitHub repo and a link to host the APK.

**App stack**

| Layer             | Choice                                                                                         | Notes                                  |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Language          | Kotlin                                                                                         | Coroutines and Flow                    |
| UI                | Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Navigation Compose                                                | One activity                           |
| Storage           | Room 2.8.5 (transactions, month budgets), Jetpack DataStore 1.3.0 (preferences); KSP 2.3.12 for the Room compiler | Local only                             |
| Widgets           | Jetpack Glance 1.2.0 (glance-appwidget)                                                        | Small 2x2 and wide 4x2                 |
| Background        | Manifest BroadcastReceiver for SMS and notification actions; WorkManager 2.12.0 (work-runtime-ktx, used by Glance for the widgets) | No foreground service                  |
| Dependency wiring | Manual (a simple AppContainer)                                                                 | Hilt not needed at this size           |
| Tests             | JUnit for the parser and budget maths                                                          | Run with ./gradlew test                |
| SDK levels        | minSdk 26 (Android 8.0); target and compile = latest stable SDK in Android Studio              |                                        |
| Build             | Gradle with version catalog (libs.versions.toml)                                               | Created by the Android Studio template |

**Android permissions**

- RECEIVE_SMS — runtime, required for capture. READ_SMS is not requested (no back-fill in MVP).
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS — runtime on Android 13+.
- No INTERNET, no location, no contacts.

**Development environment**

- Android Studio (latest stable) for the SDK, Gradle, signing and installing on the phone; Claude Code runs in its terminal, in the project folder.
- A physical Android phone with USB or wireless debugging on. Primary test device.
- **Windows on ARM laptop risk:** Google's issue tracker says there are no immediate plans to support the Android emulator on Windows ARM64 hosts ([issue 264614669](https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/264614669?pli=1)). Plan to test only on the phone, using the debug Simulate SMS tool (FR-19). Confirm Android Studio itself installs and builds on Phase 0; if it does not, build the APK with GitHub Actions instead.
- Git and a GitHub repository (required by the buildathon). Commit after every phase.

**Release and distribution**

- Release keystore created once in Android Studio (Build › Generate Signed App Bundle or APK). Keystore and passwords are never committed.
- v0.1 build is signed with a local keystore kept outside the repository (never committed); the same keystore and a higher versionCode must be used for every later build.
- Signed release APK uploaded to Google Drive (link set to "Anyone with the link") or GitHub Releases.
- Tester guide (one page): enable "Install unknown apps" for the browser or Drive, expect a Play Protect warning, allow SMS and notifications, allow Autostart on Xiaomi/Oppo/Vivo, add the widget; open the app once after installing (Android sends no SMS to a newly installed app), never Force stop it, set the battery setting for Paisa Pet to Unrestricted, and use Allow restricted settings if the SMS permission is greyed out. If a payment is not captured, add it with + Add expense and send the SMS with the digits masked.
- Play Store is out of scope; Google restricts apps that read SMS.

**External dependencies:** none at runtime. Design source is Google Stitch (screenshots only).

## Non-functional requirements

Privacy and reliability matter more than polish: a money app that leaks data or misses payments fails its one job.

| ID     | Area          | Requirement                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------ | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| NFR-01 | Privacy       | No network access (no INTERNET permission, no analytics or crash SDKs). Raw SMS bodies never stored or logged in release builds. Libraries add WAKE_LOCK, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and FOREGROUND_SERVICE (WorkManager for the widgets); none of them can send data. |
| NFR-02 | Performance   | SMS to saved transaction ≤ 5 s; app cold start to Home ≤ 2 s on a mid-range phone; Home and Transactions scroll smoothly with 500 transactions.                    |
| NFR-03 | Battery       | No foreground service, no polling; work runs only on SMS arrival, a tag, or the one daily job.                                                                     |
| NFR-04 | Reliability   | Capture works with the app closed and after a reboot. No crash on unknown SMS formats (parser failures drop the message).                                          |
| NFR-05 | Accessibility | Touch targets ≥ 48 dp; text uses sp and respects system font size; Buddy states also shown as words (never colour alone); content descriptions on icons and Buddy. |
| NFR-06 | Theming       | Light theme in P0; dark theme in P1 (US-18).                                                                                                                       |
| NFR-07 | Localisation  | English UI; Indian number format and ₹ everywhere.                                                                                                                 |
| NFR-08 | Data safety   | Database survives app updates (no destructive migrations once testers install).                                                                                    |

## Testing and QA plan

Testing runs at three levels: parser unit tests on real SMS samples, a device checklist on the builder's phone, and a 1-day test with 4–5 users.

**1\. Unit tests (Phase 1–2)**

- Every line in docs/sample-sms.txt has a test: expected keep/drop, amount, payee, reference.
- Budget maths: state boundaries at 24.99 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 100.01%, negative left, pace on the last day of the month, month key at 23:59 vs 00:00.
- De-duplication: same reference, same amount + payee within and outside 2 minutes.

**2\. Device checklist (release APK on the builder's phone)**

- ☐ Fresh install: onboarding S1 → S2 → S3 → Home; reopening goes straight to Home
- ☐ SMS denied path: denied card, manual add works, Home banner shows
- ☐ Simulated UPI debit (debug build) creates a transaction and a prompt
- ☐ Real ₹1 UPI payment with the app closed creates a transaction and a prompt within 5 s
- ☐ Misc and Essential buttons tag without opening the app; Home and widget update
- ☐ Ignored prompt shows as Not tagged and counts as Misc
- ☐ Card spend, credit, OTP and failed SMS create nothing
- ☐ Edit category, delete, manual add all recalculate totals
- ☐ Buddy shows all five states (use Simulate SMS to push spend up)
- ☐ Small and wide widgets show the right state; + Add opens the add sheet
- ☐ CSV export opens the share sheet and the file opens in Google Sheets
- ☐ Phone reboot, then a payment: still captured
- ☐ Manifest has no INTERNET permission

**3\. User test (Sunday afternoon to Monday afternoon)**

- 4–5 Android users with different banks; send the APK link and the one-page tester guide.
- Ask them to use it normally for at least a day, then send the CSV export and a screenshot of their UPI app history for the same days.
- 10-minute call or form: budget awareness score (1–5), what confused them, would they keep using it.
- Compute the success metrics from that data; fix the top 2–3 issues before submission.

**Working with Claude Code**

- One phase per session; /clear between phases; /compact if a session gets long.
